Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the Criminal Petition.
2. The said submission is placed on record.

3. The Petition is accordingly disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the petitioners to file an appropriate discharge application before the Trial Court, which shall consider the same, in accordance with law.
All rival contentions on all aspects of the matter are kept open and no opinion is expressed on the same.
